hotelDesc.overview:
Experience Luxury and Comfort at Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru

Welcome to Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru, a luxurious 5-star hotel nestled in the heart of Bangalore, India. With its impeccable service, modern amenities, and convenient location, this hotel is the perfect choice for both business and leisure travelers. Step into a world of elegance and sophistication as you enter the spacious lobby of Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru. The hotel boasts 167 beautifully designed rooms, each exuding a contemporary charm and offering a comfortable retreat after a day of exploring the city. Whether you choose a stylish Deluxe Room or opt for a more lavish Suite, you can expect nothing less than the utmost comfort and convenience. Check-in at Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru begins at 2:00 PM, allowing you ample time to settle in and make yourself at home. The hotel's check-out time is at 12:00 PM, giving you the flexibility to enjoy a leisurely morning before bidding farewell to this luxurious haven. Renovated in 2016, Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru showcases a modern and stylish ambiance that seamlessly blends with its rich history. The hotel is located just 3 kilometers away from the bustling city center, offering a peaceful retreat from the vibrant energy of Bangalore. Whether you're here for business or pleasure, you'll find yourself perfectly situated to explore the city's attractions, shopping districts, and culinary delights. Families traveling with young children will find Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru to be a welcoming haven. The hotel's child policy allows children between the ages of 0 to 5 to stay free of charge, ensuring a memorable and hassle-free stay for the entire family. With its prime location, luxurious accommodations, and impeccable service, Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru is the perfect choice for discerning travelers seeking a memorable stay in Bangalore. Experience the epitome of luxury and comfort as you indulge in the finest hospitality this city has to offer.

Unwind and Indulge in Entertainment at Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru

At Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru, guests can enjoy a wide range of entertainment facilities that are designed to cater to their every need. The hotel boasts a vibrant bar and nightclub, where guests can unwind and enjoy a refreshing drink or dance the night away to the beats of the latest music. For those looking for some pampering, the salon and spa offer a variety of rejuvenating treatments and therapies, ensuring a truly relaxing experience. In addition to the bar, nightclub, salon, and spa, Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru also offers a sauna, perfect for unwinding after a long day of exploring the city. The hotel's beautiful garden provides a serene and tranquil setting, ideal for a leisurely stroll or simply enjoying a moment of peace. For those who prefer a more social atmosphere, the shared lounge/TV area is the perfect place to relax, catch up with friends, or watch your favorite shows. Lastly, the gift/souvenir shop allows guests to take a piece of their memorable stay at Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru back home with them. With its array of entertainment facilities, this hotel ensures that every guest's stay is filled with relaxation, enjoyment, and unforgettable experiences.

Stay Active and Fit at Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru's Sports Facilities

Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru is the perfect destination for sports enthusiasts seeking an active and invigorating stay. With a range of top-notch sports facilities, guests can enjoy a variety of activities to keep themselves fit and entertained throughout their stay. Start your day with a refreshing swim in the indoor pool, where you can enjoy a peaceful and private swim regardless of the weather outside. For those who prefer outdoor swimming, the hotel also offers a sparkling outdoor pool surrounded by lush greenery, providing a serene and relaxing environment. Golf enthusiasts will be delighted to find a golf course right on-site. Whether you are a seasoned golfer or a beginner looking to improve your skills, this well-maintained course offers the perfect opportunity to enjoy a round of golf amidst beautiful surroundings. Keep up with your fitness routine at the hotel's fully-equipped fitness center, which is open 24 hours a day. Featuring state-of-the-art equipment, you can engage in a variety of workouts to stay active and energized. Additionally, the hotel also offers a free fitness center, allowing guests to exercise without any additional charges. After an exhilarating workout or a day of exploring the city, unwind at the poolside bar, where you can sip on refreshing cocktails and enjoy light snacks while soaking up the sun. With its relaxed atmosphere and stunning views, it's the perfect spot to socialize and unwind. Whether you are a fitness enthusiast or simply looking to stay active during your trip, Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru's sports facilities provide the ideal setting for a memorable stay. Indulge in a range of activities and enjoy the ultimate combination of relaxation and recreation.

Convenience Facilities at Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru

Experience a seamless stay at Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru with its range of convenient facilities. Whether you need assistance or want to relax in the comfort of your room, this hotel has got you covered. Enjoy the convenience of 24-hour room service, ensuring that you can satisfy your cravings at any time of the day. The laundry service takes care of your laundry needs, allowing you to travel light and have fresh clothes throughout your stay. Additionally, the hotel offers safety deposit boxes to keep your valuables secure, giving you peace of mind during your visit. The concierge is always ready to assist you with any queries or requests, ensuring that your stay is hassle-free. Stay connected with Wi-Fi in public areas and free Wi-Fi in all rooms, allowing you to stay connected with loved ones or catch up on work. For those who smoke, there is a designated smoking area available. Other convenient facilities include dry cleaning, express check-in/check-out, luggage storage, and daily housekeeping, making your stay at Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru a truly comfortable and enjoyable one.

Convenient Transport Facilities at Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru

At Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru, we understand the importance of hassle-free transportation for our guests. That's why we offer a range of convenient transport facilities to ensure a seamless travel experience. For those arriving by air, our hotel provides airport transfer services, making it easy for you to reach us without any stress. Our friendly and professional staff will be waiting to greet you at the airport and ensure a smooth journey to the hotel. If you're looking to explore the vibrant city of Bangalore, our hotel offers tours to popular attractions, allowing you to discover the rich culture and history of the area. Our knowledgeable guides will take you on a memorable journey, providing insights and recommendations along the way. For guests who prefer to drive, we offer valet parking and a car park onsite. You can rest assured knowing that your vehicle is in safe hands while you enjoy your stay. Additionally, we also provide car hire services, giving you the freedom to explore the city at your own pace. If you need to get around quickly, our taxi service is readily available, ensuring you can reach your destination with ease. And the best part? Our car park is free of charge, making it convenient for guests who choose to drive themselves. Whether you're traveling for business or leisure, Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru has you covered when it comes to transport facilities. We strive to make your stay as comfortable and convenient as possible, so you can focus on enjoying your time in Bangalore.

Delicious Dining Options at Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru

At Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru, guests can indulge in a variety of dining experiences that cater to every palate. Start your day off right with a delicious breakfast buffet, offering a wide range of continental options to suit all tastes. Whether you prefer a hearty meal or a light bite, the hotel's coffee shop is the perfect spot to relax and enjoy a freshly brewed cup of coffee or tea. For those looking for a more formal dining experience, the hotel's restaurant serves up a delectable array of dishes from around the world. From local Indian delicacies to international favorites, there is something to satisfy every craving. If you prefer to dine in the comfort of your room, take advantage of the convenient 24-hour room service. And for those who enjoy outdoor dining, the hotel also offers BBQ facilities where you can savor grilled delights in a charming setting. At Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru, every dining need is catered to, ensuring a memorable culinary experience throughout your stay. With options ranging from a breakfast buffet to a halal restaurant, this hotel is sure to delight food enthusiasts from all walks of life.

Luxurious and Spacious Rooms at Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru

Experience comfort and elegance at Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru with their exceptional room offerings. Choose from a variety of room types to suit your preferences and needs. The Business Class Room is perfect for those seeking a productive stay, with its spacious 30 square meters of space and the option of 2 Semi Double-Beds or 1 King Bed. For a truly luxurious experience, the Suite offers a generous 50 square meters of space and a plush King Bed.
